title: Lab - Manage partitions and swap space
description: Partition a disk and add swap two ways.
scenario: Partition a disk and add swap two ways. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Partition
tasks.instructions: Create a 1 GiB GPT partition on /dev/sdb.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Swap partition
tasks.instructions: Make it swap, enable it, and persist it in fstab.
tasks.solution:
mkswap /dev/sdb1 && swapon /dev/sdb1
echo "UUID=$(blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/sdb1) none swap defaults 0 0" >> /etc/fstab

tasks.title: Task 3 - Swap file
tasks.instructions: Add a 512 MiB swap file at /swapfile.
